name: Resistor Environment QA 12
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Potential difference within a loop using Kirchhoff's Loop Rule

examples.input: A circuit with \SI{12}{\volt} and \SI{3}{\volt} batteries and resistances \SI{1}{\ohm}, \SI{2}{\ohm} forms a loop in the following order if we start from Point A in clockwise. Point A , \SI{2}{\ohm}, \SI{12}{\volt} , \SI{1}{\ohm}, \SI{2}{\ohm}, Point B , \SI{3}{\ohm}, \SI{3}{\volt}, \SI{1}{\ohm}. To find VA - VB, which approach is most systematic?
